title: Law to toughen penalties for unsafe e-bike batteries
summary: This bill would make it illegal to possess, store or use e-bikes, e-scooters or batteries that do not meet city safety standards. It increases penalties for selling or renting unsafe devices, making violations a misdemeanor punishable by up to one year in jail plus civil fines of up to $1,000 per violation. It also sets similar penalties for assembling or selling reused lithium-ion batteries.
